ambition: Mastery (formerly Exam Mastery): 1000/1000 is the excellence standard, never a self-assigned score. No product is accepted until a human says so.
hard_rules: Never merge to main; draft PRs only.
Never modify the local RL pilot (main checkout on feat/rl-engine-pilot, 10 unpushed commits).
Historical HUMAN_REJECTED stays; never invent human or scientific approval.
No paid API/model calls (authorised budget 0); never work around provider limits.
Public repo: no lecture material, books, learner records, secrets or local absolute paths.
No clinical or safety-critical competence certification.
Do not overwrite other agents' or people's work; check open PRs/branches before writing.

science_state.summary: R0 (PR #32) audited the 55-source/52-claim KB: bibliographic checks are not claim checks; retrieval/feedback moderator rankings, transfer to proof construction, tutor non-inferiority and calendar-based mastery are overstated. No Exam Mastery learning effect has been measured. R1 is now deepening cognitive science and sustainable-intensity evidence into context-dependent policies. R1 (PR #35): 23 context-dependent design-hypothesis policies; retrieval is operation-specific, examples first for novices, feedback timing no lever, judgements reactive, sleep protection over weeks, no universal hour caps; no policy has an evaluated learning effect.

R0.note: single-agent audit; independent second extraction pending; do not re-audit

architecture_decisions.decision: Four product containers (textbook, workbook, Anki, interactive) stay; components may be NOT_APPLICABLE with a justified fallback.
Native Anki is the only scheduler; no second spaced-repetition engine without proven added value.
Architecture A/B/C (templates + expert modules / competence graph + policy engine / agent-generated experiences) decided in R6 after R1-R5.

Product identity Mastery: general knowledge-and-skill platform; exam preparation is an optional mode. Scope-neutral competency taxonomy; historical exam objectives preserved; no technical renames without a tested migration and separate approval.

critical_defects.text: No product has a measured learning effect; protocols lack sample size, allocation concealment and delayed unassisted endpoints (R0 §6).
policy.kc_status counts distinct calendar dates as spacing/mastery evidence; two dates can be minutes apart (R0 §2).
AI-R1 states tutor harm avoidance as if established; non-significance is not equivalence (R0 §2, D10).
Spec numbers (4 fading stages, 3 hints, <=5 min exploration, +-10% blueprint, <=60-word cards) are design hypotheses used as rules (R0 §6).
Golden references are session-curated; generalisable authoring quality is unproven (PR #28 limits).
Unmerged draft stack #11-#19/#28 and the local RL pilot drift apart from main; integration plan needed before engineering (P4).
